reason: The matte charcoal-black surface will create striking contrast with the dark black sesame popovers while their golden-brown tops will pop visually, and the slightly worn, well-used aesthetic gives an authentic, trustworthy rustic kitchen feel perfect for a recipe site.
pan_clause: THE PAN - wherever any part of the pan appears, it is this exact real pan: a 12-cup standard muffin pan made of matte charcoal-black nonstick-coated carbon steel, smooth and uniform, slightly raised flat rim, faint wear on the rim from use. It has 12 identical round wells in a precise 3-by-4 grid, each well about 2 3/4 inches across the top, tapering to about 2 inches at the base, about 1 3/8 inches deep, holding about 1/2 cup; the whole pan is about 14 by 10.5 inches with a flat frame around the wells. It is a real, rigid, manufactured baking pan: perfectly regular grid, every well identical, straight rows, no extra or missing wells, no mesh, no wire racks, no grates, no paper liners.
